blocks.p: From October 15 to January 14, Amazon charges its holiday fulfilment card. In the $10 to $50 column a unit pays {fill:fee-staircase:learn_peak_min} to {fill:fee-staircase:learn_peak_max} more, row for row, and the {fill:fee-staircase:surcharge} fuel and logistics surcharge comes on top.

Two things worth ten minutes before it starts. First, put your best seller into Your listing in lesson 3: it prices the unit on both cards and says what price keeps the same margin through January. Second, if any units are near 271 days old, lesson 7 prices the storage cliff, and storage itself is dearer from October to December.
Every fee in the course comes from Amazon's published 2026 schedules. If one looks wrong, reply and tell me.
